thread:
Nina (Vendor Ops): GreenBridge submitted invoice GB-0623 for $9,600. They included a note: 'US customers may be required to withhold sales tax depending on nexus'. They asked if Redwood can accept a multi-state resale cert. Invoice: https://files.redwood/greenbridge/invoice-0623.pdf

Caleb (Finance): Interesting. Resale certificates vary by state; we need to know which entity invoiced and which states GreenBridge claims they have nexus in. If they claim resale status, we need a valid resale certificate for the state where the sale is sourced.

Elena (GreenBridge): Hi team  we're GreenBridge LLC (US, Delaware). We sell inference credits to Redwood teams across multiple US states. We prefer to provide a blanket resale certificate on file rather than state-by-state each time. Will that work? Also, we're attaching our W-9.

Priya (AP): Hold placed: HOLD_REASON=RESALE_CERT_PENDING. Please upload: 1) completed resale certificate(s) for states where you claim resale/nexus, or the multi-state blanket form if available; 2) a copy of your W-9 (TIN/EIN match); 3) a brief statement of where services are delivered (customer's billing address vs vendor site). CC ap-docs@redwood when uploaded.

Jordan (Tax): Two checks: (1) Resale certificates only exempt sales tax on taxable goods/services in that state and when buyer is purchasing for resale. For software/saas some states treat it differently. (2) We need to confirm the sourcing rule: many states source telecom/software to the customer's location (our billing address) which could create nexus in states where Redwood has presence. If Redwood has nexus there, GreenBridge may not be able to self-certify resale.

Elena (GreenBridge): We have a multistate reseller certificate from our tax authority (Massachusetts blanket reseller form) and a general resale affidavit used for several states. We'll upload those plus the W-9. We don't have nexus in MA beyond registration; our team is remote. We want to avoid collecting multiple state docs each month.

tax-bot: Resale cert validation: mass-resale-2025.pdf -> STATUS: UNVERIFIED (system requires human review).

Caleb (Finance): Thanks. Key things for us: (a) the certificate must show GreenBridge LLC legal name and EIN; (b) the certificate must be valid for the state(s) listed and applicable to software/SaaS if that's the product; (c) we need to confirm Redwoods billing address as the service delivery location when sourcing.

Priya (AP): Once docs uploaded to ap-docs@redwood I'll attach them to the AP bill and we can consider exempting the invoice for the relevant state sales tax. For now invoice remains on hold. Please send a note with the exact states you want covered.

Jordan (Tax): Additional nuance: If GreenBridge is relying on a blanket reseller certificate that only covers tangible personal property, but the state taxes digital goods, we will still be liable for sales tax. We'll review the uploaded certificates and advise which states can be accepted. If necessary, we'll request a state-specific certificate (e.g., Texas resale form, California BOE form).

Elena (GreenBridge): Understood. Uploading W-9, MA blanket reseller form, and a short cover letter listing requested states: CA, NY, TX, WA. We'll flag which invoices correspond to which state billing addresses going forward. We do not require Redwood to gross-up for taxes.

Caleb (Finance): Good. Two asks for Redwood ops: (1) Vendor Ops please confirm Redwood billing address that will be used for sourcing on this invoice; (2) AP to note the states GreenBridge requested to cover.

Nina (Vendor Ops): Redwood billing address on file for this account is: Redwood Inference Inc., 425 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. I'll add that to the AP record and notify GreenBridge that CA sourcing applies.

tax-bot: Quick check: CA sourcing rule for SaaS as of 2026-06-01 -> STATE TAXABLE: Depends on customer use; human review recommended.

Jordan (Tax): Given CA billing address, CA likely sources here; we'll need a CA resale certificate specifically if GreenBridge wants CA exemption because SaaS has mixed treatment. If their MA blanket explicitly references digital goods for resale in CA, we may accept, else request CA BOE-230.

Priya (AP): Noted. Keep invoice on hold. Once ap-docs receives the W-9 + certificates (especially CA form) we'll re-evaluate and release payment if eligible. Please cc ap-docs@redwood when uploaded.

Elena (GreenBridge): Upload complete: W-9, MA blanket form, cover letter listing CA/NY/TX/WA. We'll request state-specific forms for CA and TX if needed. Thanks for quick turnaround.

Caleb (Finance): Thanks. Jordan and AP will review the files. Nina please confirm once AP releases hold.
